item.description: About 50 homes have been affected by another water main break in Dixmoor on Saturday, according to Village President Fitzgerald Roberts.This is the third water main break in Dixmoor so far this year.A water main break occurred at 143rd and Marshfield Avenue in Dixmoor on Saturday.According to officials, crews are working the fix the issue that affects about 50 homes in the area.The homes have no water as a result of the break. item.title: A 35-year-old man injured in a West Englewood shooting: police
item.description: A 35-year-old man was injured in a West Englewood shooting on Saturday, according to Chicago police.A 35-year-old man was standing near the sidewalk in the 2000 block of E. 71st Street around 7:15 p.m. Police say the victim was approached by an unknown suspect who pulled out a gun and fired shots, according to police.The 35-year-old sustained multiple gunshot wounds to his body and was transported to the University of Chicago in fair condition.Area One Detectives are investigating the incident.

item.title: Indiana residents sound off on rising NIPSCO utility bills at emergency town hall
item.description: There's more frustration from residents of Northwest Indiana over skyrocketing utility bills.
